products.name: Top T
products.title: Top T: Formula and Five-Bottle Checkout
products.intro: Top T is an Enhanced Labs capsule supplement marketed for men’s vitality. Compare the manufacturer’s four-capsule serving and the five-bottle Digistore24 checkout before deciding.
highlights: Five bottles in the verified checkout
products.labelHeading: The four-capsule serving and the EndoFlo blend
products.labelText: The manufacturer shows vitamins, minerals, botanicals and pregnenolone. These are selected manufacturer-listed amounts per four capsules.
products.labelNote: The 200 mg EndoFlo figure is for the whole blend. The listing does not give the amounts of mango, black ginger, ginkgo and pine bark within it.
packs: About $52.49 per bottle before any address-specific charges
products.costNote: The tracked offer opened a five-bottle checkout. The manufacturer’s separate storefront is not the same order.
questions: Does one order mean one bottle?
No. The initial checkout showed one order for a five-bottle package.
Does the label give a separate amount for each EndoFlo ingredient?
The manufacturer lists a combined amount for the blend.
products.delivery: The initial US-dollar checkout displayed $0.00 shipping before a full address. Check destination eligibility, shipping, tax and the total at your own address before ordering.
products.returns: Check the refund window, its start date, whether opened bottles qualify, and who pays return postage in the Digistore24 order terms. The manufacturer’s store marketing does not establish the refund terms for this checkout.
products.limitHeading: Read the formula before considering the offer
products.limitText: The supplier’s marketing is not evidence that this product changes hormone levels or treats any condition. Ask a qualified health professional to review the current label and possible interactions, especially if you take medication or other supplements. Do not assume overlapping formulas are suitable to combine.

products.title: Black Ox: Serving Size, Formula and Checkout
products.intro: Black Ox is an Enhanced Labs capsule supplement sold in the men’s fitness category. Compare the four-capsule label serving with the seller’s directions and confirm the formula in the Digistore24 order.
highlights: Manufacturer directions mention two servings a day
products.labelHeading: A serving is smaller than the seller’s listed daily total
products.labelText: The manufacturer’s product page uses four capsules for its facts table and lists four capsules twice daily in the directions. The amounts below are per listed serving, not a recommendation.
products.labelNote: The manufacturer’s summary refers to 11 ingredients while its written table has 13 entries. Compare the current bottle label with the written listing before buying.
packs: Check the quantity and total again if changing the selector
products.costNote: The tracked Digistore24 checkout and the manufacturer’s own store showed different prices. The listed figure is the initial Digistore24 amount before full address entry.
questions: Are four capsules the full daily amount shown by the seller?
Four capsules are one serving. The manufacturer’s directions list two servings, or eight capsules in total.
Can I use the direct store’s guarantee for this order?
Check the policy attached to the Digistore24 order. A different sales channel may have different terms.
